paper_metadata.title: Processing and properties of nanocrystalline CuNiCoZnAlTi high entropy alloys by mechanical alloying

evidence.quote: The present study describes the synthesis of nanocrystalline equiatomic CuNiCoZnAlTi high entropy alloy by mechanical alloying and characterized by XRD, SEM and TEM.
Elemental powders Cu, Ni, Co, Zn, Al, Ti with diameter ≤45 /H9262m and 99.7% purity with equiatomic compositions were used as starting materials.

The Vicker’s hardness of nanostructured equiatomic CuNi-CoZnAlTi HEA has been found to be 7.55 GPa in VHP condition.

Superior strength of high entropy alloy is attributed to solid solution strengthening and its nanocrystalline nature.
